The Chinese characters for Teresa

As a transliteration, Teresa is usually written 特蕾莎 (Tè lěi shā). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

Origin and meaning

From Greek, Teresa carries the meaning “harvest (of uncertain origin)”.

About the name Teresa

The name of the saint Mother Teresa, who cared for the poor of Calcutta.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Teresa as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “harvest (of uncertain origin)”, is part of the appeal.
